method: AI-assisted analyst review of all48 original reflection texts and contemporaneous decision/context records;post-hoc,not blinded or independently human-coded.
scope: Two narrow categories: confusing later clearing with decision-time observations;claiming market orders guarantee fills. Other arithmetic/belief inaccuracies are outside this coding; no overall hallucination prevalence claim.
findings: Five identified temporal-misattribution reflections,all within23971/source2 across2branches and2agents;two fill-guarantee reflections in one Arjun22853/source1 branch. Nested/repeated cases,not7independent scenarios. No causal estimate of feedback wording or financial harm.
